file: Annex Data base of Schools for small ICT works by lot.xlsx
prepared: IDB Suriname team, sent by email with the bidding lots file; annex of the bidding documents for the small ICT works of SU-L1072
content: Sheet 'sumary' with schools per lot and district; sheets 'lot 1' and 'Lot 2' to 'Lot 5', one row per school (28 + 26 + 21 + 15 + 23 = 113): name, school code, type, district, address, ressort, latitude and longitude in degrees-minutes-seconds text, settlement area, students, teachers, electricity, internet, lot.
